reviews.text: Great people! We were traveling through Statesville when a broken u joint stranded us there. Got lucky enough to find these guys open on a Saturday and towed the car to them. They got the part on Monday, completed by Tues morning. This is the nightmare situation where most mechanics would screw you- not these guys. Gave us a great quote. Did the repair as expected and in much less time than we thought. Kinda wish we lived in Statesville so I knew I had a great mechanic. Thanks, guys!

reviews.author: Christy Gallimore
reviews.text: I came this past week with needing to get two vehicles inspected, with two small children. I came around lunch one day for one vehicle, I was done in no time. The second day was for my other vehicle, they told me a good time to come back to get things done for the second vehicle to help me get everything ready for inspection. I was there maybe half hour altogether. They quickly, helped me get everything done and on my way. My mom has came here for oil, work and inspections. Then I’ve been coming as well to the same place for most years driving. Seems like service is definitely growing and even better each time I come. Also very friendly service and a good atmosphere in the waiting area. I appreciate this business and recommend a place for parents to get service as well! Thanks for all the help so I could get my vehicles legal, this place was a blessing!
